title: The Great End Update
description: Explore mysterious new landscapes, discover unique vegetation and crystal formations, and collect powerful Enderite
body:
# Enderite End Update

Enderite End Update expands the End dimension with new biomes, blocks, plants, and a brand-new resource tier called **Enderite**.

Discover mysterious landscapes, explore crystal-covered terrain, and survive in completely new End environments while collecting powerful materials for advanced gear and equipment.

---

## ✨ Features

- New End biomes
- New decorative blocks
- New plants and fungi
- Enderite ore generation
- Enderite ingots and crafting materials
- Full Enderite armor set
- Enderite tools and weapons
- Vanilla-friendly style
- Improved End exploration experience

---

## 📦 Includes

- Crystal Sand
- Crystal Shale
- Void Shale
- Chorus Moss
- Void Thorns
- Crystal Fungus
- Void Fungus
- Glimmer Bloom
- Enderite Ore
- Enderite Scrap
- Enderite Ingot
- Upgrade Templates
- and more...

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility

- Minecraft **1.20.1**
- **Forge**

---

Perfect for players and modpacks that want a larger, more atmospheric, and more rewarding End dimension experience.
